$comment: The database contract the public menu site depends on. Canonical copy lives in the
shishka-health repo because the consumer defines the contract; shishka-os fetches it
over raw.githubusercontent.com in CI (both repos are public, so no auth is needed).
Every column listed here is actually consumed by src/hooks/useMenu.js. Requesting them
explicitly (never select=*) is what makes the check precise: PostgREST answers a dropped
or renamed column with HTTP 400 naming it, and broken RLS with 401 or an empty result.
Changing this file is the signal that the contract moved. scripts/migration-canary.sh in
shishka-os blocks any migration touching these objects unless this file changed too.
2026-10-16 — the taco-bundle-pool assertion was REMOVED, not relaxed. It required at least
one menu_public row under category_code LIKE 'KP-FIN-MAN*' because lib/bundles.js builds the
bundle from that prefix and an empty pool blanked the constructor. The CEO retired the Potato
Tacos line that day (shishka-os migration 466: 8 dishes + the Set x4 archived, price_tiers
bundle4/bundle8 deactivated), so an empty pool is now the intended state and the assertion
would have failed on correct data. The taco UI in App.jsx / ManakishTiers / ManakishSets /
BundleDialog / lib/bundles.js is left in place but unreachable — it is the starting point for
the next bundle offer. If a bundle line is ever revived, re-add an assertion for ITS prefix
rather than reinstating this one.
2026-10-17 — PR 1 removed the SALE-BAKED_POTATO_SIDE -> "Sides" branch from useMenu.js. It needed
no assertion and never had one: that dish is not in menu_public, so the branch could not fire.
The Coffee hot/cold split is now the ONLY synthesized grouping left (src/lib/coffeeSplit.js),
and coffee-split below is the assertion that protects it.
2026-10-16 — the spring-rolls-section assertion was REMOVED for the same reason. It
required at least one menu_public row with product_code LIKE 'SALE-SUMMER_ROLLS*',
because useMenu.js lifted those dishes into an invented 'Fresh Spring Roll' section.
The CEO retired the rice-paper rolls that day (shishka-os migration 480) and the
invented section was deleted from useMenu.js with them, so there is nothing left for
the assertion to protect.
anonKeyComment: Public browser-facing key, already shipped in src/lib/supabase.js. Restricted by RLS to reads on the menu tables. Override with SUPABASE_ANON_KEY if it is ever rotated.

resources.name: menu_public
resources.note: Row filter is baked into the view: product_code LIKE 'SALE-%' AND is_web_visible=true AND NOT is_deleted AND name NOT ILIKE '[ARCHIVED]%'. is_web_visible is the ONLY publish switch — a dish can be live on the site while pos_status is still 'draft' (Mango Sauce is, today). Do not assume pos_status or is_available gate the site; they don't.

resources.name: nomenclature_tags
resources.note: The embedded tags(...) also proves the foreign key to tags still resolves.

resources.name: site_content
resources.note: Missing rows are survivable (lib/content.js falls back to DEFAULT_CONTENT), a missing table is not.

resources.name: price_tiers
resources.note: bundle_dish_code is filtered on but never selected — it must keep existing. minRows is 0, not 1, since the Potato Tacos line was retired on 2026-10-16 (shishka-os migration 466) and bundle4/bundle8/bundle12 are all is_active=false: there is no bundle offer today. The resource stays because useMenu.js still selects these columns, so dropping or renaming one must still fail the check — and because the next bundle offer is expected to reuse this table. App.jsx guards the empty case (bundleCards is [] when the pool is empty, and ManakishSets returns null), so zero rows renders nothing rather than an empty block.

resources.name: menu_translations
resources.note: Guest-facing translations (shishka-os mig 446), read by useMenu.js and scripts/aeo-prerender.mjs for /ru. The view returns FRESH rows only — a row whose English source changed after translation is withheld and the site falls back to English. security_invoker=false on purpose: it reads nomenclature, which anon cannot. A missing view only degrades /ru to English (useMenu treats it as optional); the /ru prerender fails the build.

assertions.why: An empty menu renders an empty site. Nothing else in this file matters if this fails.
The view is supposed to expose only sellable dishes; a NULL price reaches the guest as a blank.
The free-sauce slots in a bundle come from this prefix plus a price ceiling.

The hot/cold coffee split keys off a case-insensitive match on category_name. The split itself now lives in src/lib/coffeeSplit.js; if the CEO takes option B in SPEC §2 (real Hot/Cold subcategories via a shishka-os migration), delete that file and this assertion together.
